title: Kickin' It

services.name: Kickin' It Karate
services.desc: As the warmer months approach, parents begin searching for fun and meaningful activities for their kids to enjoy. Look no further than Kickin’ It Karate & Fitness, where our Spring and Summer Camps offer a combination of fitness, karate, exciting trips, and team-building activities. These camps aren’t just about martial arts; they are designed to provide your child with a well-rounded experience that promotes personal growth, fitness, and unforgettable memories. Why Karate? Karate is an exceptional way for children to develop discipline, focus, and confidence. At Kickin' It Karate & Fitness, we emphasize these values while helping kids build strong physical fitness through martial arts

blurb: Kickin' it Karate is a family-owned academy in Bradenton, Florida. We specialize in Kids and Adults Kickboxing and traditional Karate, Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, and Fitness. Our passionate instructors are always eager to share their knowledge and lead our Mixed Martial Arts Academy with the utmost respect. Our programs are designed for kids and adults, from beginners to advanced skill levels.
